name: Duravex
description: Duravex is a metabolic optimization compound that dramatically extends physical endurance by upregulating mitochondrial efficiency, suppressing lactic acid accumulation, and modulating the hypothalamic fatigue signals that would normally force rest. Designed for prolonged operations — extended perimeter defense, long-distance movement under load, multi-day active deployment — it allows sustained physical performance at 70-80% of peak capacity for hours without meaningful degradation.
effects: Maintained cognitive function through physical exhaustion
side_effects: Severe dehydration if water intake not maintained
Post-op metabolic crash requiring 12-24 hours recovery
Suppressed hunger masks genuine caloric deficit — users starve without realizing
Cardiac stress from sustained elevated output
Cumulative organ stress with regular use
cultural_context: Duravex is the workhorse drug of the mercenary community — unglamorous, functional, and widely used. Long-haul couriers, extraction teams, and anyone running a multi-stage operation reaches for it. The dermal patch delivery makes it subtle and consistent, which matters for operational security. On the Shelf it's valued by workers in brutal physical jobs as much as by runners — the legality line between 'labor enhancement' and 'combat stimulant' is blurry, and Novafold lobbies hard to keep it that way. 'Iron Miles' refers to the feeling of being able to keep moving long past when your body should have quit.
story_hooks: A courier who's been running on Duravex for a week straight to hit a deadline collapses delivering critical data — they're alive but the data hasn't been received, and someone is waiting for it
Novafold's Duravex supply chain has been compromised; a contaminant in the adhesive matrix is causing delayed cardiac events 72 hours after use — the company knows and is suppressing it

A crew realizes mid-op that they've been moving for nine hours and no one is tired — someone patched them without asking, and now they need to figure out who and why before they crash at the wrong moment
